snippet.title: SILENT HILL: Townfall | Launch Trailer (4K: EN/ESRB) | KONAMI
snippet.description:
SILENT HILL: Townfall launches September 24th, 2026.
https://www.konami.com/games/silenthill/townfall/order/
Fear the truth behind the static.
Watch the Launch Trailer featuring new monsters and haunting locations that await in St. Amelia.
 
Returning to an island town to ‘put things right’, Simon Ordell descends into a world of tense evasion, explosive confrontations, and mind-bending puzzles that slowly surface the truth of St. Amelia.

- SILENT HILL: Townfall
https://www.konami.com/games/silenthill/townfall/
